responsibility: This internal VxWorks compatibility header centralizes discovery and normalization of the operating system version macros used by GCC’s VxWorks wrapper headers. It safely pulls in the target system’s version.h from the expected OS include tree when _WRS_VXWORKS_MAJOR is not already predefined, temporarily suppressing _WRS_KERNEL to avoid problematic internal-header inclusion, then guarantees usable _WRS_VXWORKS_MAJOR/_WRS_VXWORKS_MINOR values and exports comparison macros such as _VXWORKS_MAJOR_GE and _VXWORKS_PRE for version-dependent preprocessing decisions elsewhere in gcc/config/vxworks.
